scope: Completed new formal RQ2 three-seed B1/B2; no new training or model evaluation
paper_claim: Across three seeds, GAM reduces old-task training-neighborhood positive CE damage and the directional sensitivity of endpoint interpolation paths under continued GAM training, while the corresponding reductions in empirical Fisher trace do not imply uniformly smaller test-neighborhood damage.
limits: All descriptive means and SD use 3 training seeds; radii and directions are correlated probes, not independent training replicates.
Dense 100-direction loss scan has all 6 branches; sparse Fisher coverage remains its predeclared smaller radius/direction grids.
Paths interpolate endpoints t0 to t1/5/9 and are not chronological optimization paths.
B2 later tasks continue GAM, unlike B3 GAM anchor followed by SGD.
Higher prefix radius means more tolerance, unlike damage quantities where lower is better; right-censored 20 means at least20, not exact tolerance.
